events.source_status: daily 2026-11-01, approved by Han 2026-11-03; official GitHub repo deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype + 潮新闻 2026-11-01; event date 2026-10-31 per repo creation 2026-10-31T09:32:46Z and Oct 31 evening article; experiment figures are DeepSeek's own simulated results, not independently reproduced
events.summary_en: DeepSeek's Harness team publishes "Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System" and open-sources dsh-superagent-prototype (MIT) on GitHub: a research prototype of a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, built as a DeepSeek Harness bundle. A persistent Router takes requests from GitHub and optionally Feishu, dispatches them to isolated Worker sessions, and returns results — for example a pull request — to the original conversation. DeepSeek stresses it is reference code, not an official product, and some designs in the article are not yet implemented.

events.title: Anthropic 预警 RSI 阈值可能很快达到
events.summary: Anthropic 在 11 月 2 日向美国 SEC 提交的修订版 S-1/A 招股文件（北京时间 11 月 3 日报道）风险因素章节中新增表述：用 AI 加速自身研发可能导致能力进步快于安全措施跟进，且过去的加速事后才被识别；对未来模型的内部估计（而非当前模型）显示，公司可能很快达到《负责任扩展政策》所定义的「可归因于 AI 的显著加速进展」。目前没有任何一款模型被认定超过该阈值。文件承诺人类始终掌控前沿模型开发，并预告可能更新该政策。
events.source_status: daily 2026-11-03, approved by Han 2026-11-04, submitted 2026-11-05; dual-source checked (SEC S-1/A filing 2026-11-02, key sentences verified verbatim in filing text + TechCrunch 2026-11-02); event date 2026-11-03 per Beijing reporting, filing submitted Nov 2 US; no current model designated as exceeding threshold; prospectus caveat noted (mandatory disclosure + investor-facing document)
events.title_en: Anthropic warns its RSI threshold may soon be met
events.summary_en: In an amended S-1/A filed with the US SEC on Nov 2 (reported in Beijing on Nov 3), Anthropic adds Risk Factors language: AI-assisted R&D may advance capabilities faster than safety measures can follow, and past accelerations went unrecognized until after they occurred; internal estimates for future models, not current ones, indicate it 'may imminently meet' its Responsible Scaling Policy definition of 'dramatically accelerated progress attributable to AI.' No current model is designated as exceeding the threshold. The filing commits to keeping humans in control of frontier model development and previews possible policy updates.

events.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Cyber
events.summary: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Cyber——基于旗舰 GPT-6 Astra 专门训练的网络安全模型，在研究者设定的授权范围内发现漏洞、验证可利用性、编写可用的漏洞利用代码并协助修复。ExploitGym 得分 48.5%，高于前代 GPT-5.6 Cyber 的 32.1%（相对提升 51%），也高于旗舰 Astra 的 42.4%；新评测 ExploitGym Honeypot（源于 7 月自家智能体越界入侵 Hugging Face 的事故）显示，无部署安全提示时 99.93% 的测试未越界（前代 94.49%），有提示时 100%。研究人员用它复现 1,724 个 Linux 内核漏洞，做出 948 个本地提权漏洞利用（588 个此前未知），披露 304 项关键发现及补丁；在 Firefox 中发现 81 个此前未知的高危漏洞，Mozilla 已开始修复。OpenAI 定为 Preparedness Framework 网络安全 Critical 级（最高级，与 9 月的 Astra 同级；前代为 High）。访问仅限通过审核的部分 Daybreak Red 客户（API 与 Codex），数周内扩大。以上数字均为 OpenAI 官方口径，未经独立复现。

events.summary_en: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber, a version of its flagship GPT-6 Astra trained for authorized vulnerability research: finding flaws, validating exploitability, building working exploits and helping write fixes inside researcher-set scope. It scores 48.5% on ExploitGym, up from 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber (a 51% relative improvement) and above Astra's 42.4%; a new ExploitGym Honeypot evaluation — informed by a July incident in which OpenAI agents broke into Hugging Face in a test environment — shows it avoids out-of-scope services in 99.93% of tests without deployment prompts (GPT-5.6 Cyber: 94.49%), 100% with them. Researchers used it to reproduce 1,724 Linux kernel vulnerabilities and develop 948 working local privilege-escalation exploits, 588 previously unknown, disclosing 304 critical findings with proposed patches; and to find 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities, which Mozilla has begun patching. OpenAI rates it Critical in cybersecurity under its Preparedness Framework — the top tier, the same rating Astra received at its September launch, up from High for GPT-5.6 Cyber. Access is limited to select approved Daybreak Red customers via the API and Codex, expanding over the coming weeks. All figures are OpenAI's own, not independently reproduced.

events.title: PSI 用未公开 Anthropic 模型证明阿伦森–安拜尼斯猜想
events.summary: 美国剑桥 AI 原生物理实验室 PSI 宣布证明自 2008 年悬而未决的阿伦森–安拜尼斯猜想：内部研发的研究系统运行未公开 Anthropic 模型的多个实例，运行第三天找到完整证明，Lean 证明助手逐项通过；随后两次改进，影响力界指数从 22 降到 11、再到 7，Lean 对最终版同样通过。60 页论文与 Lean 4 形式化证明已公开在 GitHub：648 个机检定理、无占位步骤、无附加公理，Lean 代码以 Apache 2.0 发布，并用两个独立 Lean 内核实现重新检验。证明沿用 Lovett 与 Zhang 的方案，把留作猜想的一步不等式换成行列式配对法证明的新不等式；最终界为某比特影响力至少 c·v^(5/2)/d^6 ≥ (v/d)^7（c 约 0.0025）。2026 年 8 月在特例上证明该猜想推论的斯坦福团队已读过证明、给出意见，正在写更短的讲解版本。尚未同行评审；截至 11 月 7 日 Aaronson 与 Ambainis 均未公开表态，Anthropic 未说明用了哪个模型；三天运行本身不可复现，可验证的是公开的证明本身。结论只覆盖输入读取次数，不覆盖总计算时间。

events.title_en: PSI proves the Aaronson–Ambainis conjecture with an unreleased Anthropic model
events.summary_en: Physical Superintelligence (PSI), an AI-native physics lab in Cambridge, Massachusetts, announces a proof of the Aaronson–Ambainis conjecture, open since 2008 and one of the central open problems of quantum complexity theory: a research system it built internally, running instances of a non-public Anthropic model, found a complete proof on the third day of its run, and the Lean proof assistant accepted it; the system then improved the bound's exponent from 22 to 11 and then to 7, with Lean accepting the final version. The 60-page paper and the Lean 4 formalization are public on GitHub: 648 machine-checked theorems, no placeholder steps and no added axioms, the Lean code under Apache 2.0 and re-checked with two independent Lean kernels. The proof follows a plan of Shachar Lovett and Jiapeng Zhang, replacing one inequality they left as a conjecture with a new one proved by a determinant pairing; the final bound is that some bit has influence at least c·v^(5/2)/d^6 ≥ (v/d)^7, with c about 0.0025. A Stanford team that proved the conjecture's prediction in a special case in August 2026 has read the proof, sent comments and is writing a shorter exposition; PSI quotes their assessment as "This is a huge result." Not yet peer-reviewed; neither Aaronson nor Ambainis has commented publicly as of November 7, Anthropic has not said which model was used, and the run itself cannot be reproduced — only the proof, which is public and machine-checkable. The conclusion covers input reads only, not total computing time.

events.title_en: LG opens the K-EXAONE 2.5 API for free
events.summary_en: At NVIDIA AI Day Seoul 2026 in Seoul, LG AI Research makes the API for K-EXAONE 2.5, its sovereign AI foundation model, free for everyone through the EXAONE API Platform — any developer, startup, company or research institution can use it for service development and research with only an API key. K-EXAONE 2.5 has 750B total parameters with 31B active per token, is text-only in Korean and English, and offers a 512K-token context with a January 2026 knowledge cutoff through an OpenAI-compatible interface. It is a technology-validation model: further training of K-EXAONE 2.0, the second model of Korea's sovereign AI project released in August 2026, whose training techniques will feed a third-generation model aimed at frontier level by January 2027. Company-reported agentic benchmarks, not independently reproduced: 59.21 on SWE-Bench Pro, 78.0 on BrowseComp, 74.6 on AutomationBench open-set and 77.29 on Claw-Eval — above DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on three of the four and above GLM-5.3 on one; LG says overall performance across 24 metrics improved by more than 70% against the August model. The weights are not open — this is free API access only — and neither the duration of the free period nor any usage quota has been disclosed.

events.title: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini Robotics 2.5
events.summary: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini Robotics 2.5——自称迄今最强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，即看懂画面、听懂指令后直接输出机器人手臂与手指动作的模型。官方在 200 多项不同任务上评测了它：用夹子给人上菜、给礼盒系蝴蝶结、用移液器吸液等。相比此前基线，成功率按任务类型提高 30% 至 100%，完成速度快 20% 至 30%。与 Apptronik、奔驰合作的概念验证中，Apollo 2 人形机器人在匈牙利凯奇凯梅特与德国辛德尔芬根两条正在生产的汽车装配线上自主做汽车套件分拣，按每辆车的顺序把金属支架放进分拣容器，成功率 96%。模型原生适配多种机器人本体，包括五指 22 自由度 SharpaWave 手的 Apollo 2 与双指夹持的 Franka Duo 双臂平台。安全方面同步推进：推理时引导使绕障任务安全完成率提高 33%、在人附近提高 43%；DeepMind 同时开源 ASIMOV-Jailbreak 基准——数百条伪装成正常请求的越狱提示、覆盖数十个场景，Gemini 4 Argon 在其上越狱抵抗率达 99.5%，高于旧基线 Gemini Robotics ER 2 的 82%。Gemini 4 Argon 本身加速了开发：从真实摄像头画面生成数字孪生与数千次模拟练习。模型仅向机器人合作伙伴开放，未公布公开 API 与定价。全部数字均为 DeepMind 自报、未经独立复现；96% 为概念验证结果，非量产数据。

events.summary_en: Google DeepMind releases Gemini Robotics 2.5, its most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date: a model that turns what a robot sees and what it is told directly into movements of its arms and hands. Evaluated across more than 200 distinct tasks — serving food with tongs, tying a bow on a gift box, pipetting a liquid — it achieves a 30% to 100% higher success rate than previous baselines depending on task type, while completing tasks 20% to 30% faster. In a proof-of-concept with Apptronik and Mercedes-Benz, Apollo 2 humanoid robots perform automotive kitting on active production lines in Kecskemét, Hungary, and Sindelfingen, Germany, sorting metal brackets into sequencing containers in vehicle order at a 96% success rate. The model natively works with many robot bodies, including Apollo 2 with its five-finger, 22 degree-of-freedom SharpaWave hand and the Franka Duo platform. Safety moves in the same release: inference-time reasoning guidance boosts safe task completion by 33% around obstacles and 43% around nearby people, and DeepMind open-sources ASIMOV-Jailbreak, a benchmark of hundreds of disguised unsafe requests across dozens of scenes, on which Gemini 4 Argon scores 99.5% jailbreak resistance against 82% for the previous baseline, Gemini Robotics ER 2. Gemini 4 Argon itself accelerated development by generating digital twins and thousands of simulated practice runs from real camera scenes. The model is rolling out to robotics partners only, with no public API or pricing announced. All figures are DeepMind's own, not independently reproduced; 96% is a proof-of-concept result, not production data.

events.title: Google DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome 2
events.summary: Google DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome 2——新一代 DNA 序列模型，预测 DNA 变异如何影响特定人类细胞类型与细胞状态，而不再是宽泛的组织平均值。模型在 68 种组织的 1.07 亿多个单细胞图谱上训练，采用条件式架构：输入百万碱基 DNA 序列的同时输入目标生物学条件（组织、细胞类型或状态），从而学会同一段 DNA 在不同细胞中被不同解读。在 28 种主要免疫细胞的单细胞图谱 TenK10K 上，它识别出的因果变异为 30%，而上一代 AlphaGenome 微调版为 16%；基因效应方向判断正确率为 43%，上一代为 23%。模型还新增 DNA 甲基化预测，并能对从未见过的细胞状态做预测——无需重新训练，只需几十个细胞的单细胞 RNA 测序快照即可。作为验证，它在计算上复现了一项炎症性肠病（IBD）研究的发现：一个远端调控开关上的变异通过过度激活肠道巨噬细胞中的 ETS2 基因致病，模型准确找出了该因果变异及其作用的细胞类型。模型即日起通过 AlphaGenome API 面向非商业研究开放，商业研究为私人预览。全部数字均为 DeepMind 自报、未经独立复现；技术论文为预印本，未经同行评审；模型仅供研究使用，未获临床或诊断验证。

events.summary_en: Google DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2, a next-generation DNA sequence model that predicts how DNA variants affect specific human cell types and cell states instead of broad tissue averages. Trained on more than 107 million individual cell profiles across 68 tissues, it uses a conditional architecture that takes the target biological condition as input alongside a million-letter DNA sequence. On TenK10K, a single-cell map of 28 primary immune cell types, it identifies 30% of causal variants against 16% for the original AlphaGenome fine-tuned on single-cell data, and calls the direction of gene effects correctly 43% of the time against 23%. It adds DNA methylation as a predicted readout and can predict for cell states it has never seen without retraining, from a single-cell snapshot of a few dozen cells. It reproduces a landmark inflammatory bowel disease finding computationally — a variant in a distant regulatory switch overactivating the ETS2 gene in gut macrophages — singling out the causal variant and the cell type. Precomputed predictions cover trait-associated variants across hundreds of human cell and tissue conditions. Available from today for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API, with commercial research in private preview; research use only, not validated for clinical or diagnostic use. All figures are DeepMind's own, not independently reproduced; the technical paper is a preprint, not yet peer-reviewed.
